changelog.title: A+ Core 2 Complete
changelog.description: All 12 chapter quizzes, 4 domain overview pages, and full content registry. Core 2 exam prep is now fully functional.

changelog.title: Lab QC Pass
changelog.description: 54 labs audited for navigation, task tracking, and completion stamps. Fixed 7 labs missing localStorage persistence.

changelog.title: Path Fixes
changelog.description: 67 component paths auto-corrected across Core 2 presentations, quizzes, and tools.

changelog.title: EduScan Content Scanner
changelog.description: New CLI tool scans codebase for quizzes, labs, presentations. Detects sync-breaking issues, generates TREASURE_MAP reports. Run: npm run scan

changelog.title: Analytics Dashboard (HD-6)
changelog.description: Handler Dashboard now includes completion trend chart, assignment difficulty heatmap, and class leaderboard with medals for top performers.

changelog.title: Activity Log (HD-4)
changelog.description: Live activity feed in Handler Dashboard shows student completions in real-time. Filter by student, see 'Active' badges on recently engaged students.

changelog.title: CLH Course Home
changelog.description: New dedicated landing page for Command Line Hacker with 31 modules across 7 tiers and progress tracking.
